name: astro-docs
task_summary: Scaffold Astro docs site w/ shortcuts page

spawn_spec.prompt:
Create a minimal Astro developer-docs site for the Ferryx terminal app at /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/docs.

MUST-DO steps:
1. Scaffold manually (do NOT use create-astro interactive): create docs/package.json with astro ^5 dependency and scripts { dev: 'astro dev', build: 'astro build', preview: 'astro preview' }, docs/astro.config.mjs (server: { port: 4321, strictPort: true }), docs/tsconfig.json extending astro/tsconfigs/base, src/pages/, src/layouts/, src/styles/. Use bun (bun install, bun run).
2. Dark theme matching the existing landing page: zinc palette (bg zinc-950, text zinc-100/400), monospace accents. No Tailwind required — plain scoped CSS in the layout is fine. Brand it "Ferryx Docs".
3. Layout src/layouts/Base.astro with a top header (Ferryx Docs title linking to /) and left sidebar nav: Introduction (/), Shortcuts (/shortcuts/). Keep it simple static HTML/CSS, no JS frameworks.
4. Page src/pages/index.astro — "Introduction": 2-3 neutral sentences describing Ferryx as a native Rust PTY host daemon built on Tauri v2 with split-pane tiling, embedded web companion, and mobile remote pairing. Link to the Shortcuts page. DO NOT invent any performance numbers or benchmark claims anywhere.
5. Page src/pages/shortcuts.astro — render EXACTLY this verified shortcut list (sourced from ui/src/lib/shortcuts.ts), grouped in tables:
   Tabs: ⌘T New terminal tab; ⌘⇧B New browser tab; ⌘W Close active tab; ⌘⇧] Next terminal tab; ⌘⇧[ Previous terminal tab; ⌃Tab / ⌃⇧Tab cycle tabs; ⌃1..9 Select terminal tab N; ⌘1..9 Select workspace N.
   Terminal panes: ⌘D Split terminal right; ⌘⇧D Split terminal down; ⌘⌥D Close split view; ⌘] Focus next pane; ⌘[ Focus previous pane; ⌘F Find in terminal.
   Global: ⌘K (alias ⌘P) Command palette; ⌘B Toggle sidebar; ⌘, Toggle settings; ⌘= Zoom in; ⌘- Zoom out; ⌘0 Reset zoom.
   Render keys as <kbd> elements. Add one line at top: "These match the in-app bindings defined in ui/src/lib/shortcuts.ts." Nothing more.
6. Verify: cd docs && bun install && bun run build must exit 0.

FORBIDDEN: no invented metrics, no benchmark numbers, no extra sections beyond index+shortcuts, no interactive JS.
SUCCESS: `cd /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/docs && bun run build` exits 0 and dist/ contains index.html and shortcuts/index.html.
